text_block_list.text:
To become a true party girl at heart, 
Mejiro Palmer hung out with Daitaku 
Helios. Letting loose in the city, she 
learned that the world is as fun as your 
mindset makes it.

Word of Mejiro Palmer's flashy antics 
reached the Mejiro family. Yet, the Mejiro 
Grand Dame said nothing, choosing simply 
to watch over her.
